# Dataset and job locations
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/locations
#
# The queries name no location, so BigQuery infers each job's. A script runs in the location of
# the INFORMATION_SCHEMA region it reads, as BigQuery has answered, which lets a script create a
# dataset outside the US. The datasets, named unverified_locations_*, stay in the project after the
# scripts run.

# The message for a table in a dataset of another location: a job that names datasets of two
# locations runs in the US. The second query reads the table that the first script creates.

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_locations_eu OPTIONS (location = 'EU');
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE unverified_locations_eu.t AS SELECT 1 AS x;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `region-eu`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA
?>

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM unverified_locations_eu.t, `region-us`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA
?>

# Whether only the prefix of a region qualifier must be in lower case.

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `region-EU`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA WHERE schema_name = 'unverified_locations_eu'
?>

# ALTER SCHEMA cannot move a dataset.

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_locations_eu OPTIONS (location = 'EU');
ALTER SCHEMA unverified_locations_eu SET OPTIONS (location = 'EU');
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `region-eu`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA
?>

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_locations_eu OPTIONS (location = 'EU');
ALTER SCHEMA unverified_locations_eu SET OPTIONS (location = 'US');
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `region-eu`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA
?>
